description: Anansi's free public data. action=catalog lists free endpoints and datasets; search resolves model or dataset names (q); price_current returns current per-token LLM prices (model_id); price_changes_recent lists LLM price changes in the last days (<= 7); sample returns a few raw rows of a dataset. Use it to compare LLM API costs. Limits: free routes only; prices are collected from provider pages and can lag.
name: anansi_free_data
title: LLM Price and Dataset Lookup
